faqs.answer1: <special>PERFORMANCE CORE</special> is a mechanism that helps expand your mining performance proactively, depending on the experience journey you choose.
faqs.question2: Do I have to activate <special>PERFORMANCE CORE</special>?
faqs.answer2: No. You can still participate in mining at the base level. <special>PERFORMANCE CORE</special> is only for those who want to expand their experience and optimize operational performance.
faqs.answer3: Each level corresponds to an experience phase: <special>PC-7</special> - Startup, <special>PC-21</special> - Accelerate, <special>PC-49</special> - Sustainable. You can choose the level that suits you best.
faqs.question4: Does the system require referring others?
faqs.answer4: Not mandatory. Sharing the system only helps create more interaction and feedback in your journey if you want to expand your network.
faqs.answer5: You still keep the experience you've had and can return anytime.
faqs.answer6: The system operates on a high-security platform, user data is managed and encrypted according to current standards.
faqs.question7: Can I change the <special>PERFORMANCE CORE</special> level?
faqs.answer7: Yes. You can switch to another level that better suits your experience pace in subsequent cycles.
faqs.question8: How long will it take to see a change?
faqs.answer8: This depends on how you interact with the system and your <special>PERFORMANCE CORE</special> selection.
